applicability.jurisdiction_or_standard_context: SteelConstruction.info guidance is UK/Eurocode-oriented; AISC sources provide US structural-steel context. This card is concept guidance only.

claims.text: Structural steel selection depends on strength, toughness, ductility, weldability, and durability, with design values tied to the applicable product standard.
Common section-family data for hot rolled open sections and hollow sections is published through section-property references such as the Blue Book and manufacturer catalogs.
A steel knowledge card should distinguish material and section properties from the separate design rules that check a member under actions.

limitations: Do not infer final steel grade, toughness subgrade, corrosion protection, or weldability acceptance from this card alone.
Section-property catalogs are source data for modeling and checks, not proof that a section is adequate.

pages_used: Specification for Structural Steel Buildings landing page

summary: Steel material and section-family knowledge should feed modeling and check inputs without pretending to be a final specification or code design.
title: Steel Material And Section Families
